title: Admin redesign verified locally; staging checks remain
summary: Production build, type checks, lint, API contracts and responsive browser checks passed. Two unrelated lesson harness failures and live integration verification remain.

changes.detail: Finalized system typography and preserved white headings on dark page surfaces.
Show contact mutation failures inside the mobile message-detail overlay as well as the page.
Local-only regression browser test and route inventory/validation documentation. All prior history preserved.

validation.name: Production build
validation.detail: Final production build completed with exit 0. Restricted external fetches emitted EACCES warnings; no production deployment.

validation.name: Lint and TypeScript
validation.detail: Root lint exit 0 with existing warnings; root and learning-app type checks exit 0.

validation.name: Responsive browser verification
validation.detail: 40 admin routes at nine widths 320?1280px, populated dashboard/drawer/editor checks, settings tabs, filters, pagination, support and role editor passed using local fixtures. Screenshots reviewed; fixtures are not real business data.

validation.name: Failure-path browser checks
validation.detail: Message load failure/retry/update failure, failed logout, inert drawer/Escape, no runtime exceptions, and overflow checks at 320?2560px passed. Writes intercepted.

validation.name: API contract audit
validation.detail: 180 calls and 183 routes checked with zero failures.

validation.name: Full root test suite
validation.detail: 607 passed, 2 failed, 5 skipped of 614 tests. Untouched learning-guided test harness rejects existing ../LessonTeacher import. Separate Android back tests passed.

validation.name: Change History
validation.detail: Six append-retention, storage and UI interaction tests passed; manifest check passed before this append and is checked again afterward.

validation.name: Live workflow and deployment validation
validation.detail: No production CRUD, email/payment/push delivery, Clarity authentication or real-device keyboard testing. Full dark content theme and exhaustive academy/invitation/print checks are deferred. No deployment.
